description: This file defines a virtual class 'CKEDITOR.commandDefinition' used for illustrating command object features within the CKEditor framework. It includes documentation and example code for command properties and methods, but does not contain executable logic or concrete class implementations.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition
classes.description: A virtual class illustrating command object features for CKEditor, not part of the actual API.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Function to execute the command, takes editor instance and optional data, returns boolean indicating success.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the command supports undo/redo.

methods.name: async
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the command is asynchronous.

methods.name: editorFocus
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the editor should be focused before executing the command.

methods.name: startDisabled
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the command is disabled on startup.

methods.name: modes
methods.description: Object specifying editor modes in which the command can be executed.
